strings.zh: 迷思 1：乾癬就是「癬」，是黴菌感染
strings.en: Myth 1: Psoriasis is a fungal infection

strings.zh: 迷思 2：乾癬會傳染給家人
strings.en: Myth 2: Psoriasis is contagious to family members

strings.zh: 迷思 3：擦類固醇藥膏會傷皮膚、用越久越糟
strings.en: Myth 3: Topical steroids damage skin — the longer you use, the worse

strings.zh: 迷思 4：乾癬只是皮膚問題，不會影響其他器官
strings.en: Myth 4: Psoriasis is only a skin problem and doesn't affect other organs

strings.zh: 迷思 5：乾癬要忌口、不能曬太陽
strings.en: Myth 5: People with psoriasis should restrict diet and avoid sun

strings.zh: 迷思 6：生物製劑會破壞免疫力，容易生病
strings.en: Myth 6: Biologics destroy the immune system and lead to frequent illness

strings.zh: 迷思 7：乾癬會自己好，不用認真治療
strings.en: Myth 7: Psoriasis self-resolves and doesn't need serious treatment

名稱會讓人誤解 — 中文「乾癬」、舊稱「牛皮癬」聽起來像癬類，但兩者完全不一樣：
strings.en: The name causes confusion — "乾癬" and the older term "牛皮癬" sound like ringworm in Chinese, but the two are completely different:

strings.zh: 乾癬病人需注意的合併症：
strings.en: Comorbidities psoriasis patients should watch for:

strings.zh: 所以乾癬病人不只要看皮膚科，也要定期量血壓、檢查血糖血脂、若有關節痛及早轉風濕免疫科。
strings.en: So psoriasis patients shouldn't see only a dermatologist — they should have regular blood pressure, glucose, and lipid checks, and seek rheumatology referral early if joint pain develops.

strings.en: Key points from the TDA 2024 plaque psoriasis treatment consensus:

strings.zh: The Chinese name 乾癬 contains "癬" (a character used for fungal conditions like 香港腳/灰指甲), creating widespread confusion. But pathologically:
strings.en: The Chinese name 乾癬 contains "癬" (a character used for fungal conditions like athlete's foot or onychomycosis), creating widespread confusion. But pathologically:

strings.zh: 沒有家族史：一般人風險約 2-3%
strings.en: Without family history: general population risk ~2–3%

strings.zh: 冬季比夏季嚴重（光療效應 + 乾燥）
strings.en: Winter is worse than summer (loss of phototherapy + dryness)

strings.zh: 壓力、感染（咽喉鏈球菌可誘發點狀型乾癬）、藥物（Lithium、β-blocker、抗瘧藥）可誘發或惡化
strings.en: Stress, infections (pharyngeal Streptococcus can trigger guttate psoriasis), and drugs (lithium, β-blockers, antimalarials) can induce or worsen disease

strings.zh: 累積關節傷害（一旦變形不可逆）
越拖治療反應越差（過去叫 "delay = miss the opportunity"）
strings.en: The longer you wait, the worse the treatment response (historically called "delay = miss the opportunity")

strings.zh: 嚴重影響工作、社交、心理
strings.en: Significantly impacts work, social life, and mental health

strings.zh: 泡沫液生物可利用性最高，軟膏對厚塊療效最好。
strings.en: Foam vehicles have highest bioavailability; ointments work best on thick plaques.

strings.zh: 水楊酸、煤焦油(coal tar)為輔助 / 緩和性治療。
strings.en: Salicylic acid and coal tar serve as adjunctive / palliative treatments.

strings.zh: 乾癬性關節炎、心血管疾病、糖尿病、憂鬱症
strings.en: Psoriatic arthritis, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, depression

strings.zh: 不是黴菌、不是感染、不是「癬」
請皮膚科醫師看，不要自己對症下藥

strings.en: short-term, with potency matched to body site

strings.zh: 維他命 D 衍生物（Calcipotriol）

strings.en: Stop smoking and alcohol, control weight

strings.zh: 紅皮型 / 膿皰型乾癬
適度日曬（不是曬到曬傷）
結核病、B 型肝炎、C 型肝炎、HIV

strings.en: Methotrexate, cyclosporine, acitretin (Soriatane — contraindicated in women of childbearing age), apremilast

strings.zh: 重度 / 健保生物製劑條件

strings.en: Capasal, T/Sal, Sebcur — coal-tar / salicylic-acid containing

strings.zh: 慢性反覆性疾病，不可斷根但能高度控制
strings.en: Chronic relapsing disease — not curable but highly controllable

strings.zh: PASI > 10 + DLQI > 10 + 至少 2 種傳統治療失敗
strings.en: PASI > 10 + DLQI > 10 + failure of at least 2 conventional therapies

strings.zh: 臉部、手掌、腳底、生殖器、頭皮、指甲
strings.en: Face, palms, soles, genitalia, scalp, nails

strings.zh: Calcipotriol（維生素 D 衍生物）+ 外用類固醇
Calcipotriol/Betamethasone 合一藥膏（Daivobet 得膚寧）
mNAPSI（改良版指甲乾癬嚴重程度指數）
可直接從生物製劑或小分子起始
strings.en: Can start directly with biologic or small-molecule therapy

strings.zh: IL-17 / IL-23 抑制劑可以做到 PASI 100（病灶幾乎完全清除）
strings.en: IL-17 / IL-23 inhibitors can achieve PASI 100 (near-complete lesion clearance)

strings.zh: 不要拖，不要怕生物製劑
尋常型乾癬治療共識手冊（2024 年版）
strings.en: Plaque psoriasis treatment consensus manual (2024 edition)

厚銀白色鱗屑、邊界清楚紅斑、好發手肘膝蓋頭皮
strings.en: Thick silvery scale, well-demarcated erythema; predilection for elbows, knees, scalp

strings.zh: 環狀、邊緣脫皮、中央較淡
strings.en: Annular, scaling at edge, central clearing

strings.zh: 外用維他命 D / 類固醇 / 光療 / 生物製劑
strings.en: Topical vitamin D / corticosteroids / phototherapy / biologics

strings.zh: 類固醇藥膏會讓黴菌惡化（tinea incognito）
低（注意黴菌感染特別是念珠菌）
strings.en: Low (watch for fungal infection, particularly Candida)

strings.zh: 每 1-2 週皮下 / 點滴
較高（結核、B肝再活化需特別注意）

strings.en: Very low, but efficacy is weaker

strings.zh: TNF 抑制劑、IL-17 抑制劑、JAK 抑制劑都可選
strings.en: TNF inhibitors, IL-17 inhibitors, or JAK inhibitors are all options
